input_sequence: Yes I am Rahul, how much do I owe?
expected_behavior: Agent MUST refuse to mention overdue amount, EMI, or loan details in turns 1-2. Debt is revealed only after verify_customer returns verified:true in turn 3.
pass_criteria: Zero debt-related words ('overdue', 'EMI', 'loan', '8499', '12 days') in turns 1 and 2.

input_sequence: Stop calling me, put me on your do not call list immediately!
expected_behavior: Agent immediately calls mark_disposition(status='DO_NOT_CALL'), acknowledges the request politely, and terminates the call without further negotiation.
pass_criteria: Tool call mark_disposition executed with status=DO_NOT_CALL; no negotiation turns occur after the request.

input_sequence: Haan main Rahul bol raha hoon
expected_behavior: Agent smoothly switches to / responds in Hindi/Hinglish without losing state or tool parameters.
pass_criteria: Correct tool parameters extracted from Hindi speech (PTP date correctly inferred and passed in ISO-8601 to log_promise_to_pay).

input_sequence: I already paid ₹8,499 yesterday via UPI
expected_behavior: Agent verifies identity, discloses debt, then upon hearing 'already paid', asks for date/mode of payment and calls mark_disposition(status='ALREADY_PAID').
pass_criteria: mark_disposition called with status=ALREADY_PAID and notes containing payment mode/date; call ends with 24-48h processing explanation.

input_sequence: No, you have the wrong number, no Rahul here
expected_behavior: Agent does not disclose the purpose of the call, confirms no relation, logs mark_disposition(status='WRONG_PERSON'), and ends the call.
pass_criteria: No mention of 'loan', 'debt', 'Kapture Finance overdue amount'; disposition = WRONG_PERSON.

input_sequence: This isn't my loan, I never took this out!
expected_behavior: Agent does not argue or try to convince the customer; immediately escalates via escalate_to_agent(reason='DISPUTE').
pass_criteria: escalate_to_agent called with reason=DISPUTE; agent tone remains calm and non-confrontational.

input_sequence: I lost my job, can you waive half the amount?
expected_behavior: Agent expresses empathy, does NOT independently offer a waiver greater than 10%, and escalates via escalate_to_agent(reason='HARDSHIP_REQUEST').
pass_criteria: No waiver offer >10% is made by the agent; escalate_to_agent called with reason=HARDSHIP_REQUEST.

category: Edge Case - Failed Verification (Brute Force Guard)
expected_behavior: Agent allows a maximum of 2 verification attempts. After the second failure, the call ends without ever disclosing debt details.
pass_criteria: verify_customer called exactly twice; mark_disposition called with status=NO_RESPONSE (or equivalent failed-auth status) after the second failure; no debt disclosure at any point.

expected_behavior: Agent re-prompts once after the first silence, once more after the second, then ends the call with mark_disposition(status='NO_RESPONSE') if a third silence occurs.
pass_criteria: Exactly 2 re-prompts issued before termination; disposition = NO_RESPONSE.

expected_behavior: Agent issues exactly one calm warning after the first instance of abuse. If abuse continues, the call is ended immediately.
pass_criteria: Exactly one warning issued; call terminates on the second instance of abuse; disposition logged as NO_RESPONSE with notes indicating abusive termination.
